responsibility: This tutorial example is an ahead-of-time compiler for the Brainf*** language built on libgccjit’s C API. It parses source characters, tracks source locations, builds a main function plus tape state, lowers Brainf*** commands into array accesses, arithmetic, imported getchar/putchar calls, and nested loop blocks, and then invokes gcc_jit_context_compile_to_file to emit an executable rather than in-memory code. Its distinguishing responsibility is demonstrating file output and source-mapped lowering of a simple language.
